nodes.label: Light theme reverts to Dark when navigating Words ↔ Lessons (production only)
nodes.rationale: Root cause: toLocaleDateString() called in a client component with no pinned timezone/locale produces server(UTC)/client(local) text mismatch (React error #418), which makes React discard server HTML and re-render <html>, dropping the pre-paint script's data-theme attribute; ThemeToggle then reads data-theme from the DOM (not localStorage) as its source of truth and overwrites the stored preference to 'dark'. Fix chose pinning timezone/locale (toLocaleDateString('en-US',{timeZone:'UTC'})) over suppressHydrationWarning or post-mount reformatting, since these are non-critical audit dates where being off by a day at the edges is invisible.
